purpose: Compare independent atmospheric observations with the fixed PR202/203 station-day; close stale documentation, then judge cloud persistence and thermodynamic structure without new model runs or coefficient tuning
surface_archive: IEM archived operational METAR/SPECI, original raw message retained; not labelled as NOAA research-quality-controlled surface observations
primary_sounding: 2016-10-06 nominal18UTC, actual release1734UTC; use MMMSS elapsed-time decoding per official IGRA format, not nominal hour as every-level time
vertical_comparison_method: separate measured and derived quantities; log-pressure interpolation between valid data only, no extrapolation; retain each field QC flag and missing marker. No temporal interpolation of bracketing soundings into a manufactured17–20UTC profile
model: existing PR202 cold native NetCDF at original fixed cell37,119, plus existing PR203 bounded actual microphysics states; read only, use dry perturbationtheta+300, pressure, native height and density conventions
humidity: IGRA reported RH and dewpoint depression retained. Derive comparable water-relative humidity and mixing ratios using unchanged native UDM saturation functions, keeping native-derived values distinct from reported observations
representativeness: 27km grid and point/balloon observations differ; archive station coordinates are not automatically verified2016launch coordinates; no per-level balloon drift or observed turbulent cloud-water flux is available from these products
decision: report actual atmosphere–model differences and retain/limit the current research applicability. Attribute no unique PBL coefficient/optical defect solely from these observational constraints
selection_note: 17–20UTC and original station were selected in the prior review; sounding18 actual release was discovered in fetched source. This is diagnosis of the same station-day, not an independent new forecast skill case
